101
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the August 17, 2005/Sravana 26, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Non-
Conventional Energy Sources; Power; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions —20
Extension of SEZ facilities
*321. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of  COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian
Apparel Export Units are demanding for
extending SEZ facilities to their units set
up outside SEZ;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
Government of Andhra Pradesh has
requested for opening up of SEZ; and
(d) if so, the details of the request and
the action that has been contemplated on
that?
Production of tea in Kishanganj
district, Bihar
†*322. SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that tea gardening
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
and production has started in Kishanganj
district of Bihar in the last few years;
(b) whether it is also a fact that as per
survey better quality of tea can be grown
in Kishanganj and Araria districts of Bihar;
(c) whether it is also a fact that tea
growers have not got any incentive from
any level and they have to face adverse
conditions; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the steps
Government propose to take to encourage
tea production in the said areas?
Effect of cheap Chinese tyres on
domestic tyre industry
†*323. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that large number
of Chinese tyres are coming to India via
Nepal and other countries and sold at cheap
rates, as a result of which domestic tyre
industry is affected adversely and going
through a deep crisis; and

102
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto and the details of action taken so
far/to be taken to save the domestic
industry from this crisis and to stop the
unauthorized import of Chinese tyres in
the country;
Terrorist organizations active in
capital and nearby areas
†*324. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that several
terrorist organizations are active in the
Capital and its nearby areas at present;
(b) if so, the details of active terrorist
organizations;
(c) whether it is also a fact that these
terrorist organizations have spread their
network in the whole of Western Uttar
Pradesh also; and
(d) the details of steps taken by
Government for eliminating these
organizations from the Capital and its
nearby areas?
Power situation in Delhi
*325. SHRI MANOJ
BHATTACHARYA:
SHRI C. RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of POWER  be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Delhi's power situation
particularly supply has been steadily
deteriorating since the power distribution
was privatized a few years back;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether the proposed hike in power
tarrif togetherwith large scale faulty bills
and installation of defective meters have
added to the common man's woes of
frequent load-shedding;
(d) if so, action taken/proposed against
errant companies for their lapses; and
(e)  the measures proposed to give relief
to the citizens?
Harassment for dowry
*326. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
HOME AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of women who
committed suicide due to constant
harassment for dowry by the victim's
husband or her in-laws during the last three
years, State-wise;
(b) the number of cases filed against
their husbands and in-laws for the last three
years;
(c) the State-wise details of such cases;
(d) whether Government had initiated
action against persons found guilty; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Children killed by army ambush
in J & K
*327. SHRI PRAMOD MAHAJAN:
SHRIMATI SUSHMA
SWARAJ:
 Will the Minister of  DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
an army ambush killed three innocent
Children in J & K; and
(b) if so, what steps Government are
taking so that such mistakes do not happen
in future?

103
Decline in rural employment rate
*328. SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE: Will the Minister of
RURAL DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in recent
years rural employment rate has declined;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the proposals and action plan of
Government to improve the situation?
Agency to investigate the discrepancy
in the figures of textile exports
*329. SHRIMATI SYEDA ANWARA
TAIMUR: Will the Minister of
TEXTILES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
discrepancy in the figures of textile exports
from the country and Government had
appointed a professional agency to study
the discrepancy in the figures; and
(b)

Review of trade agreements
†2349. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Committee on Trade and Economic
Relation has reviewed different trade
agreements in its meeting held recently;
(b) if so, the decisions taken in the review
meeting;
(c) whether decision to formulate a job
oriented policy was also taken in the
meeting; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Export of medicines
2350. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL:
SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) what is the total export of
pharmaceuticals to foreign countries during
the last one year;
(b) what are the names of first ten
pharma companies who have achieved
maximum export orders of pharmaceuticals;
and
(c) what steps Government propose to
take for companies in their plans to export
more pharma stock?
Import and export of bulk drugs
2351. SHRI UDAY PRATAP SINGH:
SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India imports
and exports large number of bulk drugs;
(b) if so, what are the names of these
bulk drugs imported and exported;
(c) what is the quantity and value of
each bulk drug imported and exported,
during 2003-2004; and
(d) what are developmental plan and
non-plan schemes and policy measures to
increase exports and be self-sufficient in
others?

333
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
New Patent Amendment Bill
†2352. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS BAL
APTE: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
bring new Patent Amendment Bill;
(b) if so, by when;
(c) whether objections from the public
have been received in this regard;
(d) if so, the number of proposals under
consideration; and
(e) the steps being taken to implement
these proposals?
Incentives to States producing export
quality tea
†2353. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any special scheme
for giving incentives to the States which
produce tea suitable for exports;
(b) the details of assistance being
provided to various States under this
scheme;
(c) whether Uttaranchal has sent any
proposal for special assistance for revival
of old areas of tea production and extension
of new areas; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Bilateral trade with Sri Lanka
2354. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) with the present $1.8 billion bilateral
trade between India and Sri Lanka as a result
of Free Trade Agreement, what are the
projections for this bilateral trade for the
year 2005 and 2006, especially when a
Comprehensive Economic Partnership
Agreement was negotiated in the sixth
session of Sri Lanka-India Joint
Commission held recently;
(b) what is the quantum of trade for
diversified items and the traditional items
during the last two years;
(c) whether development projects in
power, education and allied fields give
further fillip to our ongoing trade; and
(d) if so, any broad projections thereof?
White Paper on talks with WTO
2355. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
had secret talks with the World Trade
Organisation on serious issues that affect a
vast majority of people;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that many
have demanded a White Paper  on talks
with the World Trade Organisation; and
(d) if so, whether Government is
considering to bring in a White Paper on it?
Targets for Indo-Pak trade after
SAFTA
2356. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) what targets have been fixed, over
the existing one, the bilateral trade between
India and Pakistan after introduction of
South Asian Free Trade Area (SAFTA)
from January 1, 2006;
(b) whether wheat export to Pakistan is
also be included over and above the 600

334
items which Pakistan is presently
importing from India; and
(c) as Pakistan is presently importing
wheat from Russia, US, etc. on
comparatively high price, will Government
be initiating negotiations in this regard?
FDI in cement and steel captive
mining
2357. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have decided to allow 100 per cent FDI in
cement and steel captive mining;
(b) the current rate of FDI allowed
